newsitem.title: USA: Grossman's sees improvement at two chains.
newsitem.headline: Grossman's sees improvement at two chains.

text.p: Grossman's Inc said Thursday that its Mr. 2nd's Bargain Outlet and Contractors' Warehouse stores are showing signs of growth after months of decline.

Total sales at Contractors' Warehouse rose 8.1 percent for the October period and 9.3 percent for the year-to-date. Total sales at Mr. 2nd's Bargain Outlet rose 40 percent for the October period and 21.5 percent for the year-to-date.

Comparable-store sales for October at Contractors' Warehouse were down 3.9 percent and down 5.2 percent for the year-to-date. At Bargain Outlet, same-store sales were up 7.2 percent for October and down 1.9 percent year-to-date.

"While we have a long way to go, we're making progress," Chairman and Chief Executive Robert Swanson said in a statement. "It has taken time to recover from low inventory levels. Now are focused on bringing our customers back."
